title: Sunday · the Rain, 2009
logline: Twelfth January. The frame shop's rain alley. The buckets. The dog, ten, under the eave instead of in it.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the rain alley. Two buckets. Rain. Wood on one, in the rain. The dog under the eave, dry, ten.

characters.pose: on a bucket in the rain

image.prompt: a narrow alley in dense rain with a man sitting on an upturned spackle bucket in the wet and an old dog sheltering dry under the eave, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Wet and dry

panels.composition: Tier 2: the dog's face under the eave, watching him.

image.prompt: close-up of an old dog's face under an eave watching someone out in the rain, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Watching

panels.composition: Tier 3: Wood has carried the bucket under the eave and sits beside the dog. Both dry. The rain, held.

characters.pose: on the bucket under the eave

image.prompt: a man and an old dog side by side under a shop's eave, a spackle bucket brought in from the rain, the alley pouring beyond, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Both dry

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; Sundays the point

notes: The 2001 Rain's framing inverted: this time the dog stays dry and Wood comes in.
